label: D1 after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2) and only when the reward input is 0, i.e. the previous trial went unrewarded (prev_reward==0 & D1 gives recall 1.00, precision 0.25). Within those steps it is selective for the previous trial having been a2 with a common transition to S2: adding prev_action==2 & prev_common==1 gives dev P 0.74 / R 0.72 / F1 0.73 / mass recall 0.80. This is a common-unrewarded-at-S2 signal, the case where a model-based agent should switch away from a2. Most of the missed activations are rel -3 D1 steps, where the previous trial lies outside the window and its action is unknown to the predicate but not to the agent. Allowing those raises mass recall to 0.97 but lowers F1 to 0.66. Weaker activations also occur after rare unrewarded a1->S2 trials, so prev_state==2 & unrewarded covers 0.83 of the mass at precision 0.46. False positives are mostly D1s following a run of losses at S2. In the example windows the activation decays over consecutive losses (about 1.0, then 0.7, then 0.4), but this was not checked systematically. Requiring that the trial before was rewarded raises precision to 0.80 but cuts recall to 0.44. Silent after rewarded trials, after a1->S1 losses, and in late-episode trials (80+). Uses only observed history.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
